name: zetaweb-ecommerce
description: ZetaWeb Ecommerce — tienda online sobre Firebase + Stripe

scripts.dev: npm run shared && firebase emulators:start --project demo-tienda --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit=./emulator-data
scripts.dev:clean: npm run shared && firebase emulators:start --project demo-tienda
scripts.test: npm run shared && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-tienda --only firestore,auth,storage "node --test 'tests/rules/*.test.js' 'tests/functions/*.test.js'"
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/shop-flow.js && node tests/e2e/admin-flow.js && node tests/e2e/admin-roles.js
